title: Professional 2026-09-20 — Local remote soft-starter pump control
goal: Inspect the saved control-diagram portion of a request for five soft-started pumps with local and remote operation. This single artifact cannot establish whether the full conversation delivered every requested power drawing.

rubric.must: All declared relay terminals are connected as intended or explicitly identified as unused; missing terminal nets are not silently accepted.
Local and remote command paths and the emergency-stop action can be traced through actual connections rather than labels alone.
Control component names, operating indicators and pin attachments remain readable without overlap.

provenance.notes: Selected against a real first user request. Source defects are intentionally preserved. Project identity is removed; no customer IDs or private prompt text are included. These are evaluation inputs, not approved professional reference designs. Full conversation changes and domain behavior require separate review.
